findings.title: MetricAlertDetectorHandler can no longer be instantiated
findings.body: MetricAlertDetectorHandler now inherits from StatefulDetectorHandler but implements none of its abstract members (counter_names, get_dedupe_value, get_group_key_values, and the newly added build_occurrence_and_event_data). Instantiating it via Detector.detector_handler will therefore raise TypeError: Can't instantiate abstract class, instead of behaving like the previous implementation whose evaluate() returned []. process_detectors only handles a missing handler, not this exception, so any detector of type metric_alert_fire will crash processing rather than being skipped or producing no results.

findings.title: StatefulDetectorHandler.evaluate docstring still documents a list return
findings.body: The evaluate() signature and implementation were changed to return dict[DetectorGroupKey, DetectorEvaluationResult], but the docstring still says it 'returns a list of DetectorEvaluationResult'. Implementers and callers following the documentation will use the wrong contract (e.g. list append/iteration semantics) for the new dict-keyed API.

findings.title: Mock occurrence builder ignores the value passed to the new hook
findings.body: build_mock_occurrence_and_event accepts a value argument but never uses it when constructing the IssueOccurrence or event_data, and MockDetectorStateHandler.build_occurrence_and_event_data forwards the evaluated value only into this helper. The tests themselves pass mismatched values (for example group_2 has packet value 10 but the expected occurrence is built with 6, and several evaluate tests expect occurrences built with 6 for values 8/100). Consequently a regression that passes the wrong value to build_occurrence_and_event_data would not be caught by these tests, even though real handlers will typically use that value in titles/evidence/event data.
